dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: :products products · :locations locations
dashboard.welcome_subtitle: Three steps to start tracking stock
dashboard.step_locations_note: You cannot count what you cannot place, and a date list is no use on a walk round the store if it does not say where.
dashboard.step_products_note: Scan a barcode, take a photo, or tell the assistant.
dashboard.step_targets_note: A product with no target never appears in Running low, however low it gets.
dashboard.shopping_note: Built from what is running low and what is nearing its date. You tick items off in the list.
dashboard.calm_description: Nothing has expired, is nearing its date, or has fallen below target. Use the actions above to add something new.

location.delete_note: This location is empty and can be deleted.
location.delete_blocked: It cannot be deleted while it holds products or locations. Move what is inside somewhere else first.
location.delete_description: The location is removed for good. Its name still appears in past movements.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: :total locations · :roots top level
locations.filtered_hint: All :total locations hold stock. An empty place needs a location first.
locations.empty_description: Stock goes into a location, so you need at least one. Start with top-level places like Kitchen and Pantry, and add shelves later.

mcp.title: Connect your own assistant
mcp.subtitle: Open your stock records to your own AI
mcp.scope_description: A connected program can read stock, locations and dates. It cannot add, change or delete anything.
mcp.address_note: This address belongs to your team alone. Do not share it.
mcp.empty_description: Add the address to your own assistant and authorise it, and it will be listed here.
mcp.revoke_description: Every connected program loses access and has to be authorised again. This cannot be undone.

plan.title: Plan and usage
plan.subtitle: What is metered, and what stops at the limit
plan.renewal: The free plan does not expire. Upgrade whenever you want to.
plan.meter_products_note: At the limit no new product can be added. Existing products, stock changes and reports keep working.
plan.meter_credits_note: When they run out, receipt reading, photo recognition and web search stop. The assistant still answers from computed data, and manual entry is unaffected.
plan.meter_history_note: Changes older than this cannot be queried. They are not deleted: upgrading brings them back.
plan.seats_note: Team members are not metered. Adding someone costs nothing on any plan.

product.activity_empty_note: Record the first stock-in or stock-out with the two buttons below. The history a forecast needs starts here.
product.archive_description: It leaves every list. Its movement history and stock records are not deleted, and it can be brought back.
product.locations_empty_note: You are asked for a location when stock comes in, and it is suggested for you after that.
product.lots_empty_note: Every stock-in opens a batch. Once a date is entered, this is where you see which batch to use first.
product.write_failed: The change could not be saved

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How the app behaves
settings.assistant_note: Adding stock, taking it out, scanning: everything can be done by telling the assistant. Turned off, the assistant is reachable only from its own screen.
settings.start_note: Which way in sits at the top of the overview.
settings.verb_assistant_note: You describe what happened in a sentence.
settings.verb_inventory_note: You find what you are after in the list.
settings.local_note: These preferences are kept on this device.
settings.mode_manual_note: You always pick the location yourself; nothing is suggested.
settings.mode_suggested_note: A location is suggested with its reason, and you accept or change it.
settings.mode_auto_note: A location is assigned without asking. It can be undone and it is written to the history. If your correction rate rises, this drops back to Suggested on its own.
settings.placement_note: Who decides where incoming stock goes.
settings.inbox_note: Forward your receipts or e-archive invoices to this address and they are read automatically, then put to you for confirmation.
settings.link_plan_note: Products, AI credits and how far back history goes
settings.link_mcp_note: Open your stock records with read-only access
settings.digest_note: One notification a day: what is close to its date and what has run low. Tapping it opens the overview.
settings.alert_dates_note: Always on. Without it the summary has nothing to say.
settings.alert_low_note: Products that have fallen below their target level.
settings.alert_count_note: A monthly nudge for locations nobody has counted in a while.
